title: Kit Wires Vfs Hover Selection Sync
description: Kit Wires Vfs Hover Selection Sync
summary: Fixed live hover and selection sync between kit wires diagram and kit VFS in sketchpad. FiveD2d now respects host-controlled puzzle2d hover/selection props instead of always using its internal store. SketchpadKitWires always publishes puzzle2dSelection (including empty clears) and subscribes to shell route selection. Platform puzzle5d renderer passes empty selection arrays. Kit VFS model always reads kitWiresNodeIds from route selection. Added vitest coverage for hover and selection clearing sync.
